Settings.Description_ENG: Auto-extracted schema for RebelCommand_Settings.ini. Descriptions come from the INI file's own ; comments. Generated by ja2-launcher/tools/build_ini_schemas.py.

Property.name: INCOME_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: Base supply income modifier. A higher number increases income. Valid range is 1.0-100.0.

Property.name: MAX_LOYALTY_NOVICE
Property.Description_ENG: Each town's maximum loyalty is reduced based on the game's difficulty setting. Maximum loyalty can be increased through an administrative action. Omerta's maximum loyalty is always 100%. Valid range is 20-100.

Property.name: ADMIN_ACTION_COST_INCREASE_REGIONAL
Property.Description_ENG: Each administrative action purchased increases the cost of all subsequent ones. Note that these costs stack, so purchasing an action in one region increases the cost of the next one in the same region by both regional and national modifiers. Valid range is 1-100.

Property.name: BASE_LOYALTY_GAIN_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: Loyalty rises slower when playing with Rebel Command. Does not affect loyalty loss. Valid range is 0.1 (10% loyalty gain) to 1.0 (100% loyalty gain. ie, normal).

Property.name: MILITIA_STATS_UPGRADE_COSTS
Property.Description_ENG: Militia stats can be upgraded, making them perform better in tactical combat. The number of times that they can be upgraded is the number of values in the costs array. The stat bonus covers physical stats - Health, Strength, Dexterity, and Agility. Valid range for bonus per level is 0-10.

Property.name: GATHER_SUPPLIES_COSTS
Property.Description_ENG: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ DIRECTIVES ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Each directive becomes available after a certain point in the game, represented as a value between 0 (just started a new game) and 100 (endgame, usually approaching Meduna). The progress requirement values below set when each directive becomes available. Valid range for progress requirement is 0-100. Note that it is possible to chance the number of times a directive can be upgraded. To do this, add or remove integers from the _COSTS variable. Note that the number of values in the effect variable must be one more than the number of costs. For example, GATHER_SUPPLIES_COSTS = 1000,2000,4000,8000 GATHER_SUPPLIES_INCOME = 3, 6, 12, 25, 50 Daily supply income boost This directive is always available.

Property.name: SUPPORT_MILITIA_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Daily militia upkeep modifier

Property.name: TRAIN_MILITIA_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Militia training modifier, and militia training speed bonus

Property.name: CREATE_PROPAGANDA_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Loyalty increase modifier This does not provide a daily loyalty gain, and it does not modify loyalty losses

Property.name: ELITE_MILITIA_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Daily elite militia spawn

Property.name: HVT_STRIKES_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Chance that the strike succeeds, per high value target Officers, medics, radio ops, snipers, and heavy weapons specialists are targetted Note that enemies can still spawn with specialist gear, but they won't have the skills to use them as effectively Requires Enemy Roles (ENEMYROLES) and enemy traits (ASSIGN_SKILL_TRAITS_TO_ENEMY) to be enabled Enemy officers (ENEMY_OFFICERS) and medics (ENEMY_MEDICS) are recommended to be enabled for a better experience

Property.name: SPOTTERS_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Modifier values are indices for the ubResolutionTable160 and ubResolutionTable360 arrays defined in "overhead map.cpp" Changing modifier values is not recommended unless the above arrays also change. Basically, higher indices give more precision.

Property.name: RAID_MINES_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Stolen mine income modifier (0.1 = 10%), and chance that a raid completely fails

Property.name: CREATE_TURNCOATS_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Create turncoats in enemy groups at the cost of intel

Property.name: DRAFT_PROGRESS_REQUIREMENT
Property.Description_ENG: Draft civilians to the volunteer pool Requires Volunteers (MILITIA_VOLUNTEER_POOL) to be enabled. The per-day modifier is based on the user's progress (0-100), so a modifier of 1 means that 50 volunteers will join each day at 50% progress.

Property.name: SUPPLY_LINE_MAX_LOYALTY_INCREASE
Property.Description_ENG: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ADMINISTRATIVE ACTIONS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Each Administrative Action can be purchased and then upgraded once, with the exception of Supply Line, which is repeatable until the region's max loyalty is >= 100. In-game, this is represented as the Tier of the action, for a maximum of Tier 2. This does not apply to the Supply Line action, which can be purchased until the town's max loyalty >= 100. Supply Line Each time you upgrade a supply line, the towns max loyalty increases by this value. Valid range is 1-100. Maximum loyalty increases by this amount per Tier.

Property.name: REBEL_RADIO_DAILY_LOYALTY_GAIN
Property.Description_ENG: Rebel Radio This is the amount of loyalty points that a region gains per day. Unfortunately, there's no simple way to convert points to loyalty percentage. See Cities.xml. Valid range is 1-10000. Loyalty increases by this amount per day per Tier.

Property.name: SAFEHOUSE_REINFORCE_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Safehouses Free militia can show up at the beginning of a combat encounter in or adjacent to the town. Valid range for reinforce chance is 1-100. Note that the actual reinforce chance is whatever is the LOWER value of this value and the region's loyalty. Valid range for minimum and bonus soldiers is 0-10. Tier 1 gives MINIMUM + up to BONUS green militia, plus a 50/50 chance for one regular militia. Tier 2 gives MINIMUM + up to BONUS regular militia, plus a 50/50 chance for one elite militia.

Property.name: SUPPLY_DISRUPTION_ENEMY_STAT_LOSS
Property.Description_ENG: Supply Disruption In tactical, enemy soldiers lose this amount of stats per level of disruption. Success rate is determined by the region's loyalty. Valid range is 0-100. Enemy stats decrease by this amount per Tier.

Property.name: DEAD_DROPS_DAILY_INTEL
Property.Description_ENG: Scouts No variable effect, but included for completeness. Strategic vision expands by 1 sector per Tier. Dead Drops Requires Intel (RESOURCE_INTEL) to be enabled. Regions with higher loyalty will provide more Intel. Valid range is 0-100. Intel granted per day is up to this value per Tier.

Property.name: SMUGGLERS_DAILY_SUPPLIES
Property.Description_ENG: Smugglers Valid range is 0-100. Supplies granted per day is up to this value per Tier.

Property.name: WAREHOUSES_DAILY_MILITIA_RESOURCE_GUNS
Property.Description_ENG: Warehouses Requires Militia Resources (MILITIA_REQUIRE_RESOURCES) to be enabled. Valid range is 0-100. Resources granted per day is up to these values per Tier.

Property.name: TAXES_DAILY_INCOME
Property.Description_ENG: Taxes Daily income is modified by the "coolness" of a sector, so "harder" towns will provide higher tax income. Regions with higher loyalty will provide more taxes. Valid ranges are 0-10000 for both values. Taxes and loyalty daily changes are per Tier.

Property.name: TAXES_DAILY_LOYALTY_LOSS
Property.Description_ENG: This is the amount of loyalty points that a region loses per day. Unfortunately, there's no simple way to convert points to loyalty percentage. See Cities.xml.

Property.name: ASSIST_CIVILIANS_DAILY_VOLUNTEERS
Property.Description_ENG: Civilian Aid Requires Volunteers (MILITIA_VOLUNTEER_POOL) to be enabled. Regions with higher loyalty will provide more volunteers. Valid range is 0-100. Up to this value will be granted per day per Tier.

Property.name: MERC_SUPPORT_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Merc Support This is a percentage boost to mercs who are on assignment (doctoring, training militia, repairing, etc). Valid range is 0-100. This boost is doubled at Tier 2.

Property.name: MINING_POLICY_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Mining Policy Bonus Increase daily income by this percentage for captured mines. This action will only appear for towns that have mines. Valid range is 0-100. This boost is doubled at Tier 2.

Property.name: PATHFINDERS_SPEED_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Pathfinders Friendly forces move faster on foot in sectors around the town. This value is a percent reduction in the time it takes to move to a new sector. eg, if this is set to 20, a 120-minute travel time would be reduced to 96 minutes (20% reduction) Valid range is 0-100. This boost is doubled at Tier 2.

Property.name: HARRIERS_SPEED_PENALTY
Property.Description_ENG: Harriers Enemy groups move slower on foot in sectors around the town. This value is a percent increase in the time it takes to move to a new sector. Valid range is 0-100. This penalty is doubled at Tier 2.

Property.name: FORTIFICATIONS_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Fortifications Militia are stronger when fighting in the town. Valid range is 0-100. This boost is doubled at Tier 2.

Property.name: MISSION_BASE_COST
Property.Description_ENG: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ AGENT MISSIONS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Agent missions are intended to be powerful, but temporary, passive boons to the campaign. Several missions can be active at once, but the cost of starting new ones increases with the number of currently-active missions. In order to begin a mission, a mercenary must be in a friendly town and not on another long-term assignment (eg, a Mini Event or on a mission). Once a merc has been selected to start a mission, they will be gone for 24 hours to prepare. Once this time is elapsed, the merc will return to your control and the mission's effects will begin - if the mission was successful. Note that it is possible to use a generic rebel agent instead of your mercs, but they will provide no bonuses to the mission. Note that if a merc has multiple skills that give bonuses to a mission, only the biggest bonus will be used. How many supplies it costs to prepare a mission. Valid range is 100-10000.

Property.name: MISSION_ADDITIONAL_COST
Property.Description_ENG: Additional supply cost per active or in-prep mission. Valid range is 0-10000.

Property.name: MISSION_PREPARATION_TIME
Property.Description_ENG: A merc must prepare a mission for this many hours before a mission starts. Rounded up to the next hour. Valid range is 1-168.

Property.name: MISSION_REFRESH_TIME_DAYS
Property.Description_ENG: New missions will become available at this interval. A value of 2 means that available missions will be refreshed at Day 2 00:00, Day 4 00:00, etc. Valid range is 1-7.

Property.name: MIN_LOYALTY_FOR_MISSION
Property.Description_ENG: The minimum loyalty that a town needs to be in order to prep a mission from it.

Property.name: DEEP_DEPLOYMENT_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Deep deployment When deploying your mercs onto a map for a battle, the valid deployment area extends further across the map.

Property.name: DEEP_DEPLOYMENT_RANGE_NS
Property.Description_ENG: Range, divided into north/south and east/west

Property.name: DEEP_DEPLOYMENT_DURATION
Property.Description_ENG: Duration, in hours

Property.name: DISRUPT_ASD_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Disrupt ASD Reduce ASD income and prevent deployment of new robots/jeeps/tanks This does not appear if the ASD feature is disabled

Property.name: DISRUPT_ASD_INCOME_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: Income modifier. 0.6 = income reduced by 60%

Property.name: DISRUPT_ASD_DURATION
Property.Description_ENG: Duration, in hours

Property.name: FORGE_TRANSPORT_ORDERS_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Forge Transport Orders Creates a transport group with orders to go to the agent's location

Property.name: STRATEGIC_INTEL_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: No duration. The group is created immediately upon mission success Strategic Intel When viewing teams on the strategic map, enemy movement targets are displayed in red.

Property.name: STRATEGIC_INTEL_DURATION
Property.Description_ENG: Duration, in hours

Property.name: IMPROVE_LOCAL_SHOPS_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Improve Local Shops Shopkeepers will have better inventories. (+1 coolness level)

Property.name: IMPROVE_LOCAL_SHOPS_DURATION
Property.Description_ENG: Duration, in hours

Property.name: SLOWER_STRATEGIC_DECISIONS_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Slower Strategic Decisions Strategic enemy AI will spend more time between taking action against you.

Property.name: SLOWER_STRATEGIC_DECISIONS_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: Modifier - note that skill modifiers override the base modifier

Property.name: SLOWER_STRATEGIC_DECISIONS_DURATION
Property.Description_ENG: Duration, in hours

Property.name: LOWER_READINESS_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Lower Readiness In tactical, enemies have their sight range reduced until they're alerted to your presence

Property.name: LOWER_READINESS_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: Modifier - enemy vision is reduced by this percentage

Property.name: LOWER_READINESS_DURATION
Property.Description_ENG: Duration, in hours

Property.name: SABOTAGE_EQUIPMENT_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Sabotage Equipment Enemy soldiers use worse than normal equipment.

Property.name: SABOTAGE_EQUIPMENT_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: Quality modifier - enemy weapons and armour quality will be reduced by this amount

Property.name: SABOTAGE_EQUIPMENT_DURATION

Property.name: SABOTAGE_VEHICLES_SUCCESS_CHANCE

Property.Description_ENG: Modifier - enemy vehicles will have their stats reduced by this amount (to a minimum of 33)

Property.name: SABOTAGE_VEHICLES_DURATION

Property.name: SEND_SUPPLIES_TO_TOWN_SUCCESS_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Send Supplies Passively grow town loyalty.

Property.name: SEND_SUPPLIES_TO_TOWN_INTERVAL
